messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I remember carrying jithu on my back everyday... My back used to ache but I never stopped carrying him.

output.original_text: I remember carrying jithu on my back everyday... My back used to ache but I never stopped carrying him.
output.joy: I remember how joyful it was to carry jithu on my back every day... Even when my back ached, I just couldn't stop because he brought me so much happiness.
output.sadness: I remember carrying jithu on my back every day... My back used to ache, but I kept carrying him because I didn't want him to feel alone.
output.fear: I remember carrying jithu on my back every day... My back ached, and I sometimes worried if I could keep going like this.
output.anger: I remember carrying jithu on my back every day... My back would ache, yet I never stopped, even though I felt so frustrated at times.
output.surprise: I remember carrying jithu on my back every day... I was surprised at how much my back ached, but I just never stopped!
output.disgust: I remember carrying jithu on my back every day... My back ached, and honestly, I sometimes felt disgusted by how much I had to endure to help him.
